resources.string: Three things before the bubble can run. Test it stationary first — never set this up while driving.
Workspace ID (wrkspc_…) — only if asked for
Leave blank unless Claude says "anthropic-workspace-id is required".
Get one at console.anthropic.com — it stays on this phone.
Long-press the bubble to talk, tap it to cancel, drag it to move it.
Sent to Claude with every question. Paste an export of your Claude memory here — the API can\'t read it on its own.
e.g. I drive an electric car, I\'m usually heading to Bristol…
Say a phrase instead of long-pressing. Runs entirely on the phone — no account, no key, and no audio leaves the device to detect it.
hey claude, hey cloud, hey clawed

Any of these, separated by commas, will start a session. The offline recogniser has no \"claude\" in its vocabulary, so it usually hears \"cloud\" or \"clawed\" — keeping those spellings is what makes it fire reliably.
Only listen while Google Maps is open
Keeps the recogniser off when you are not navigating, which is where nearly all of the battery cost is. Carries on for three minutes after you leave Maps, so switching to music doesn\'t stop it.
Needs usage access to see when Maps is open.
Listening for a wake word keeps the microphone open and uses noticeably more battery than the long-press. Turn it off when you are not driving.
Delete every saved conversation? This can\'t be undone.
Nothing yet. Long-press the bubble and ask something.
Maps Voice is listening for a long-press
